text_block_list.text: —I've decided to change my mind. Yes...

"I should stop. Forcing my own methods 
onto Wonder Acute, that is."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Our guiding principle! Tracen Academy 
stands for 'Umamusume First'!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, Umamusume come first! 
Fellow Trainers, do not ever forget this!

I recall Chairwoman Akikawa's words. The 
foundation of training —is to respect the 
Umamusume.

"Rather than forcing your own perspective, 
you adapt to the other person's situation. 
That's right—"
choice_data_list: Back to basics, one more time!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, the basics, huh.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“—A Trainer's job is to bring out an 
Umamusume's full potential to the absolute 
fullest. They must dedicate themselves 
entirely to that.”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I take it that's more or less what you 
were thinking.

It was just as pointed out. You cannot 
raise an Umamusume while neglecting the 
essential fundamentals.

I will return to my roots as a Trainer 
once more, and then—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"At first glance, it looks correct. 
However... haven't you forgotten something 
important?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What kind of Umamusume Acute-san is, you 
know? Yes, she is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...that I am "not an Overlord."

I couldn't understand what she meant. Of 
course Wonder Acute isn't T.M. Opera O...

What was she trying to say? As I stood 
there pondering...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If she is the Supreme Overlord, all one 
needs to do is follow her. As long as no 
one stands in her way, she will claim the 
throne.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She is the Overlord, after all. I just 
need to keep her in good spirits. But...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, she is no supreme ruler. 
No, it is not just her— most Umamusume are 
not supreme rulers.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Vessels not originally meant to be kings. 
Such Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You think that just watching over them 
with a bright smile will lead them to the 
top? Do you truly believe that?
choice_data_list:
Just smile brightly... and watch over 
them...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Returning to the basics" might sound nice 
on paper. However, that is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you merely averting your eyes from 
what you must face? From the thorny royal 
road where you must hurt yourself, and at 
times hurt the Umamusume, in order to 
advance.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Make no mistake. Becoming the protagonist 
isn't something achieved merely by "being 
as you are"—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Our world is not so soft. Every year, it's 
an audition where thousands of Umamusume 
compete for the leading role.
choice_data_list: Every year, thousands of Uma Musume...

text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O took a breath—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Your method of "hard training" is one 
valid answer. Provided it's done with 
thorough calculations, that is.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san recognizes that too. So why are 
you giving up on yourself?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do not close your eyes simply because you 
lack confidence. Your duty is not to look 
away, but to watch.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Look closely. At your own actions, at your 
beliefs. And at the Umamusume known as 
Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Open... your eyes!

"It wasn't something I could just gain 
confidence in so easily. Life at Tracen 
Academy... was filled with nothing but 
setback after setback."

I simply close my eyes—and clench my 
teeth. How could I possibly face a reality 
where I don't even know what to do...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ho, so you refuse to look no matter what? 
In that case—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Allow this Overlord to show you! Even if 
I have to force your eyes open."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With an Umamusume's power, doing whatever 
I wish to that frail body of yours would 
be child's play.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Grit your teeth! I'm gonna slam you onto 
the concrete!

By the time I was startled, it was already 
too late.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Overlord Shoulder Throw! 
TAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!
My body was lifted into the air! And then—

I flipped once and fell on my back! 
Feeling a light impact, I reflexively 
opened my eyes.
And right there—

...I could see the sky. A blue sky 
stretching endlessly onward.
Yes, this sky is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, one more lap! Let's run one more, 
yeah? I'm still good to go~!

It was the very same sky I had always 
looked up at together with Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely. You must never set a 
ceiling upon yourself.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That is a canopy that confines you, 
confines those around you, and brings 
misery to everyone.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Break through. For yourself, and for 
Acute-san."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What kind of play has no trials or 
tribulations? Beyond the dark clouds, a 
blue sky always awaits.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Look them straight in the eye and speak of 
what is happening, not out of your own 
convenience.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I believe that alone is quite enough. 
...See you later.

...Before I knew it, the pain in my back 
had subsided. She must have gone easy on 
me when she threw me.

After T.M. Opera O left, nothing remained 
but the clear blue sky.

"‘Look them in the eye and speak.’ Keeping 
those words in mind, I headed over to the 
training grounds..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a girl in my class said you just 
tap-tap a few times and you can 
"down-load" it, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
These 'apps' are so difficult, aren't 
they? If it were an email, I could view 
it, though.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. This is... it's not what it 
looks like, really...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure I can check it myself. That 
way I won't bother anyone by asking every 
single time~.

The way she just spoke... Could Wonder 
Acute possibly be—

Could it be that, simply because she uses 
a flip phone, she wasn't able to download 
the meal tracking app?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, sorry about that. Going out of your 
way to print out stuff from the "appli" 
for me~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have to eat quite a lot, huh. It's 
pretty different from what I imagined, 
geez.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh, what else?
choice_data_list:
Things you held back from telling me out 
of hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I thought if I just put up with it, 
it'd go away on its own eventually, but 
well...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, my toenail has been 
throbbing with pain lately...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well, how about it, Trainer?

I'm glad she told me. Wonder Acute's 
hooves are small, and her growth hasn't 
caught up at all...

At this rate, there was no way she could 
handle more intensive training. Immediate 
action was required.
—Rub, rub, rub, rubbb.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ahyahya... Trainer, that tickles. It 
tickles so much, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I feel like my feet are doing a lot 
better. This medicine is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Pain-Be-Gone-All!? Well, no wonder it 
took away the pain, huh."

The name sounds goofy, but the ingredients 
are the real deal. It's the latest 
hoof-filler for Umamusume with thin 
hooves.

And so, if she protects her hooves and 
gets proper nutrition, Wonder Acute should 
likely—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hooooryaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! No matter how much I run, I 
don't get palpitations, shortness of 
breath, or dizziness anymore~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for all the trouble I've caused 
you. But thanks to you, Trainer...
choice_data_list: I'm the one who should be sorry...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hae? Trainer, why the long face...?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, I just can't seem to gain any 
confidence...

text_block_list.text:
We had built up a record of achievements 
together with Wonder Acute. Yet, I still 
hadn't been able to shake off my old 
weaknesses.

Still—things are different now. My eyes 
won't be clouded anymore.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know what's wrong, but... 
there, there, Trainer. Cheer up. And 
then...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Could you push me harder with basic 
training? For the sake of the Japan Dirt 
Derby.

"By looking each other in the eye and 
speaking their minds honestly, their 
relationship took a firm step forward."

Now we can finally head toward it. Toward 
the big showdown—the Japan Dirt Derby.
